title: Pattern generator
summary: The opposite of the logic analyzer: play any digital pattern of up to 1024 steps on 16 pins, up to 100 million steps per second, checked at the pins.

slots.2: Pattern table (1024 words, bit n = pin n)

wiring: the circuit under test, or a scope / logic analyzer
3.3 V levels, keep the current small (under 8 mA)
parts: a scope or logic analyzer to see the patterns
tested: the self-test passed 9 of 9 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
